success.description: Taal the hunter makes you vigilant while you rest. While you slumber, you and all your sleeping allies within close range may add {Dc} to your Observation and Discipline checks. If a successful check awakens you, you lose the bonus until you return to sleep

bane.description: If awakened during the night, all targets wake up with 1 stress and 1 fatigue

reckless.requirements: avour. You invoke this blessing as you settle in to sleep for the night. It recharges at sunrise
